mark.name: Morning Sprig Book

meaning.book: Scripture as the root of the devotional life

mark.geometry: open-book base with an upward sprig and small rising sun
mark.clearSpace: one sun diameter on all sides

iconography.selectedState: same geometry with semantic domain color and slightly stronger optical weight

botanicals.usage: one meaningful botanical gesture per major composition

landscapeArt.construction: broad quiet layers, limited detail, no gradients required

composition.bibleContext: 5:2 and optional; never behind Scripture paragraphs

landscapeArt.colorLimit: canvas + sage family + one morning-gold accent

generatedArtDirection.masterPrompt: Quiet editorial landscape for My Daily Devotion, early-morning natural light, restrained watercolor and fine ink character, warm ivory paper atmosphere, muted sage and olive hills, small golden morning sun, generous negative space, simple natural forms, mature Christian devotional publishing aesthetic, no people, no text, no logos, no gradients, no fantasy, no photorealistic stock-photo look.
consistencyRules: all scenic art must feel painted by one restrained editorial illustrator
prefer broad shapes over fine visual noise
gold appears only as a small light cue
do not use generated art as a substitute for interface hierarchy

darkMode.rule: use the same geometry with lower motif opacity and warmer pale sage; do not invert raster art
darkMode.scenicTreatment: prefer separate dark-toned illustration or simplified line motif rather than filter inversion
